about: Varvee Global Ltd (formerly Aarvee Denims & Exports Ltd) is an Ahmedabad-based textile company operating from the Narol facility. After a 2024–25 control change, it is pivoting from denim manufacturing to non-denim shirting/suiting, B2B job work, trading and leasing; it incorporated a renewable-energy subsidiary in July 2026.
